explanation: The claim 'the effect is not cumulative across cycles' is not stated in any evidence. Evidence only says neutropenia is mostly transient/manageable by dose modification; it does not address cumulative effect across cycles.
suggested_rewrite: Median duration of Grade 3+ neutropenia was 7 days; neutropenia was mostly transient and manageable by dose modification without appearing to compromise efficacy (omit cumulative-effect claim).
